questions.question_text: Explain the aphorism 'Paper has more patience than people' as expressed by Anne Frank.
questions.correct_answer: Paper listens silently to one's innermost thoughts without judgment, fatigue, interruption, or betrayal.
questions.explanation: Anne felt that human friends might lack time or empathy, whereas a diary absorbs thoughts faithfully without criticizing.
